title: B-tree recursive and connection-wide shared-cache mutex ordering

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeEnter/Leave provide recursive demand over a non-recursive BtShared mutex, while btreeLockCarefully is the deadlock-avoidance slow path that releases locked later Btrees, acquires the requested mutex, then reacquires every later wanted mutex in ascending list order.
excluded_responsibilities: BtShared mutex allocation and connection ownership

external_source_responsibilities: Connection mutex is already held; pNext is sorted by BtShared address; mutex try/enter/leave operations are supplied by the active Btree owner
dependencies.caller_closure: Complete per-Btree recursive entry, careful acquisition, leave, and internal connection-wide traversal bodies are assigned. Native VDBE uses the per-Btree owners; public noSharedCache-gated all-Btree wrappers and connection-backed BtShared mutex dispatch remain open.

inputs: Btree in an ascending same-connection chain and typed try/lock/unlock operations
outputs: Recursive enter demand with target lock acquisition; careful ordered reacquisition on contention; final leave unlock when demand reaches zero
contracts.ownership: All Btree nodes, BtShared mutexes, and callback context are borrowed. No allocation or list mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Non-sharable entry/leave are no-ops. Sharable entry increments wantToLock and acquires only on the first level. Final leave unlocks at zero. A failed try unlocks each locked later node before blocking on target, then reacquires wanted later nodes in list order.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex. Mutex callbacks run synchronously and may block only in the lock operation after larger-address locks have been released. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Mutex enter/leave callbacks are infallible under the source interface. List/lock consistency is asserted before mutation.

representation_differences: Opaque BtShared mutex access is represented by typed try/lock/unlock operations while Btree locked/wantToLock/pNext state remains source-layout data.
The source lock helper also assigns BtShared.db; that opaque owner update remains the callback provider's responsibility and is not yet represented by the bounded VDBE seam.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace records callback order for successful try, nested recursive enter/leave, and failed try with one locked later node plus one unlocked wanted node; compare exact event order, wantToLock, and every final locked flag. Pinned-C contended mutex trace remains pending.
oracle.normalization: BtShared pointer addresses are represented by explicit ascending linked-list order; callback event order and lock state are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Real two-connection contention and process mutex integration remain pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Unsorted, unsharable, or locked-without-demand list states violate source assertions.
assurance.continuation: On return the target and all later wanted locks are held consistently for caller continuation.
assurance.performance: Fast path is one try operation; contended path is linear in later Btrees and preserves source lock ordering.

integration.native_call_path: enterBtrees/leaveBtrees call btreeEnter/btreeLeave for selected source-layout Btrees; first entry calls btreeLockCarefully. The bounded default seam succeeds without contention.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Real BtShared mutex dispatch and db publication remain open.

independent_review.notes: Requires real BtShared mutex integration, contended pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect operations to the configured BtShared mutex and publish BtShared.db.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btmutex.c:19-154 was reviewed completely for lock/unlock helpers, recursive Btree entry assumptions, careful try/release/reacquire ordering, and leave behavior
upstream/sqlite/src/btmutex.c:156-260 was reviewed for EnterAll/LeaveAll ordering and mutex assertions
src/core/internal/vdbe_types.zig Btree layout and src/core/internal/vdbe_lifecycle.zig lock-mask caller were reviewed
callers: sqlite3BtreeEnter increments wantToLock and invokes the helper only for an unlocked sharable Btree
btreeEnterAll/LeaveAll traverse every connection database for schema-wide locking
Native enterBtrees invokes the helper for selected unlocked source-layout Btrees
callees: sqlite3_mutex_try performs the nonblocking fast path
lockBtreeMutex blocks only after later locks are released and republishes locked state
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 32 active behavior IDs cover chain/connection/lock assertions, non-sharable and recursive returns, try success, both later-list traversals, conditional unlock/reacquire, leave demand/final unlock, connection traversal, and noSharedCache publication
Failed try releases all locked later nodes before target acquisition
upstream_tests: Upstream shared-cache, mutex, unlock-notify, multi-connection, and threads tests cover this ordering boundary
